facts.text: The Greek Amphitheatre at PLNU was the first Greek theater built in the United States, with construction beginning on July 1, 1901.

sources.title: Buildings & Locations | PLNU
sources.quote: The Greek Amphitheatre at PLNU was the first Greek theater built in the United States. Construction began on July 1, 1901.

facts.text: PLNU was founded in Los Angeles in 1902 by Dr. Phineas Bresee, who was also the founder of the Church of the Nazarene.
